capabilities.safeAlternative: request task owner or supervisor to initiate drain/cancel transition

capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-CASE-WRITE-001 authority on mission/case scope
capabilities.safeAlternative: request mission investigation role or record local hypotheses

capabilities.capability: read minimal evidence/decision subgraphs and counterfactuals
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-EXPLAIN-001 authority on authorized decision/evidence domain
capabilities.safeAlternative: request explanation access role or query top-level outcome summary

capabilities.capability: append correction, adjudication, outcome, or learning proposal
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-FEEDBACK-001 authority on episode/event/case
capabilities.safeAlternative: request feedback role or submit offline evaluation report

capabilities.capability: publish a redacted root-last handoff capsule
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-HANDOFF-WRITE-001 authority on mission/workspace + recipient scope
capabilities.safeAlternative: request handoff delegation authorization or retain session locally

capabilities.capability: submit an exact prepared plan to domain effect authorities
capabilities.defaultRole: denied unless explicit; never substitutes for domain effect capabilities
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-PLAN-COMMIT-001 authority on plan digest + fences
capabilities.safeAlternative: submit prepared plan to human supervisor for manual approval and domain dispatch

capabilities.capability: compile and seal a witnessed contingent plan
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-PLAN-PREPARE-001 authority on mission + objective + target domain
capabilities.safeAlternative: request planner role or inspect established affordance frontier

capabilities.capability: compile and execute bounded semantic queries

capabilities.safeAlternative: request agent query role or query standard pre-aggregated views

capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-SESSION-OPEN-001 authority on deployment + mission + principal
capabilities.safeAlternative: authenticate principal credentials and negotiate session contract basis

capabilities.capability: read/resume exact workspace or handoff revisions
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-SESSION-READ-001 authority on mission/session/workspace root
capabilities.safeAlternative: authenticate as session principal or request delegated continuation

capabilities.capability: read capability-projected SituationFrames, deltas, and obligations
capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-AGENT-SITUATION-READ-001 authority on deployment/mission/zone/time
capabilities.safeAlternative: request agent read role or query minimal public SituationCapsule

capabilities.denialReason: ERR-AUTH-DENIED-001: principal lacks CAP-REPAIR-PREPARE-001 authority on subsystem/object scope

errors.description: device adapter registry file is corrupt or missing mandatory fields
errors.guidance: repair or restore device adapter registry file

errors.description: device adapter canonical freeze digest does not match pinned generation digest
errors.guidance: recompute canonical device adapter registry digest or bump generation

errors.description: adapter generation does not match current system generation
errors.guidance: fail closed; assign expected generation to device adapter registry

errors.description: adapter tier is invalid or violates promotion rules
errors.guidance: fail closed; reject unsupported tier

errors.description: adapter response violates typed protocol
errors.guidance: terminate adapter generation; retain fixture

errors.description: adapter registry row drift between machine registry and markdown
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/device_adapters.json and registries/DEVICE_ADAPTERS.md

errors.description: deterministic replay adapter produced state root or audit hash diverging from reference proof
errors.guidance: fail closed; reject diverged replay output and quarantine bundle

errors.description: adapter row violates semantic invariants (tier, state, gate)
errors.guidance: fail closed; enforce normative row definitions

errors.description: adapter stable identifier was reused, renumbered, or resurrected
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: recommended next move lost a precondition, capability, lease, or validity interval
errors.guidance: refresh/replan; never execute cached recommendation

errors.description: natural-language request has multiple materially different interpretations
errors.guidance: return interpretations; choose only a registered safe-read default or request clarification

errors.description: ContractBasis registry digest specifies unsupported algorithm (Blake3 prohibited; Sha256 required)
errors.guidance: compute registry digest with canonical SHA-256 algorithm

errors.description: ContractBasis binary envelope magic header does not match CONTRACT_BASIS_MAGIC
errors.guidance: verify binary envelope format or use canonical encoder

errors.description: ContractBasis binary envelope trailing checksum verification failed
errors.guidance: recompute checksum or retransmit uncorrupted envelope

errors.description: ContractBasis identifier field failed pattern, length, or character set validation
errors.guidance: provide identifier matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9:._+/-]*$ within length limit

errors.description: ContractBasis binary payload or envelope exceeds maximum permitted byte limit
errors.guidance: reduce payload size within configured bound or check framing

errors.description: ContractBasis binary envelope contains unexpected trailing bytes after declared payload
errors.guidance: strip extraneous trailing bytes and ensure canonical framing

errors.description: ContractBasis binary envelope ended prematurely before declared length or minimum envelope size
errors.guidance: retransmit complete binary envelope without truncation

errors.description: ContractBasis binary envelope format version is unsupported
errors.guidance: upgrade client or server to matching format version

errors.description: investigation cannot discriminate remaining hypotheses within declared budget
errors.guidance: return residual uncertainty and explicit next probe/approval options

errors.description: requested decision-complete context cannot fit or lacks required evidence
errors.guidance: return bounded partial with omissions/expansion handles; never imply completeness

errors.description: explain named an event identity that no committed `event_revision` delta publishes at the evaluated anchor
errors.guidance: orient to list published events; retry only after the ledger head advances

errors.description: follow named an anchor token past the deployment's committed ledger head or effect-journal records
errors.guidance: orient again and follow from the current anchor token; never follow from a position the history has not committed

errors.description: follow named an anchor token whose site lineage is another deployment's
errors.guidance: orient this deployment and follow from the anchor token it emits

errors.description: follow named an anchor token whose binding does not match the deployment's committed history at its position (altered token or divergent history)
errors.guidance: orient again and follow from the anchor token it emits; never rebase silently onto another history

errors.description: follow continuation is not a cursor of the exact stream (altered, issued for another anchor, view, or page size, or issued before the head advanced)
errors.guidance: follow again without the continuation to receive the first page of the current delta

errors.description: handoff root is incomplete, expired, unauthorized, schema/generation-incompatible, or cannot be safely rebased
errors.guidance: reject, migrate, or open a new session with an explicit invalidation report; never silently resume

errors.description: session resume named a handoff identity that no root in the deployment's agent publications holds (never published, or its publication was interrupted before the root became visible)
errors.guidance: resume only a handoff identity `fss handoff` returned for this deployment, or hand off again

errors.description: required mission state exists only in conversation or caller memory
errors.guidance: persist typed mission/workspace/case/plan/finding/handoff state before proceeding

errors.description: learning proposal lacks evidence, applicability, counterexamples, or validation path
errors.guidance: retain as rejected/advisory; do not activate

errors.description: no safe, authorized, useful next action exists under current evidence/budget
errors.guidance: explain blocking clamps and return wait/escalate/stop reason

errors.description: presentation attempted an unregistered verb/view or changed semantic meaning
errors.guidance: reject and repair registry/transport drift

errors.description: continuation cannot advance coherently from its exact basis
errors.guidance: request a fresh situation capsule; do not splice generations

errors.description: external effects/obligations prevent a truthful resumed terminal state
errors.guidance: resume in reconciliation mode; no effect retry before lookup/proof

errors.description: session handoff named a session that is unknown, closed, expired, or held by another principal in the deployment's agent-session journal (deliberately indistinguishable)
errors.guidance: open a session with `fss session open` or resume a published handoff; never guess another principal's session

errors.description: session, workspace, or resumed handoff basis no longer satisfies required anchor/generation/freshness semantics
errors.guidance: rebase and enumerate every invalidated assumption, alias, grant, lease, plan, continuation, and affordance before proceeding

errors.description: the deployment's agent-session store failed verification (journal rollback or foreign journal against its pinned root, an incomplete append, an orphaned publication temporary, or a missing mission record)
errors.guidance: inspect `agent/` under the deployment root; the store is never repaired, truncated, or re-pinned implicitly

errors.description: another session command holds the deployment's agent-session store lock
errors.guidance: retry after the other command finishes; the store is never shared by two writers

errors.description: CLI/MCP/TUI/report semantic payload or digest differs for equivalent input
errors.guidance: block affected surface/release and retain differential transcript

errors.description: requested multi-agent work scope overlaps an incompatible live claim, lease, or fence
errors.guidance: narrow, wait, delegate, release, or supersede with explicit authority; never last-writer-wins

errors.description: agent abstraction registry or markdown documentation file is missing or corrupt
errors.guidance: repair or restore agent abstraction registry file

errors.description: agent abstraction registry digest does not match canonical encoding of metadata and rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical agent abstraction registry digest

errors.description: agent abstraction registry digest diverged from pinned baseline freeze digest
errors.guidance: restore frozen agent abstraction registry or bump generation

errors.description: agent abstraction registry generation diverged from baseline generation
errors.guidance: assign expected generation to agent abstraction registry

errors.description: derived beliefs or non-authority abstraction layer illegally claims authority or authorizes effects
errors.guidance: preserve cognition plane boundary; derived layers cannot claim authority or authorize effects

errors.description: agent abstraction layer invariant or prohibition violated
errors.guidance: enforce layer semantic invariants and constitutional prohibitions

errors.description: agent abstraction layer row or root metadata lacks a mandatory field or is empty/corrupt
errors.guidance: declare all mandatory fields in agent abstraction layer row

errors.description: agent abstraction registry row drift between machine registry and markdown mirror
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/agent_abstraction_stack.json and registries/AGENT_ABSTRACTIONS.md

errors.description: agent abstraction layer stable identifier was reused, duplicated, renumbered, or tombstoned
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: an alert plan or dispatch approval digest does not match the current plan, route, principal, prepared record or deadline; nothing was prepared or sent
errors.guidance: rerun without the stale approval and review the reported digests

errors.description: the event is absent, or its current authority, prepared plan or receipt cannot be read and verified against the ledger
errors.guidance: inspect or repair the deployment; never dispatch from unverified authority

errors.description: the admission clock is unavailable or behind the effect journal's last transition
errors.guidance: repair the host clock; nothing was committed

errors.description: the durable effect journal or live webhook authority refused before any network I/O, or the observation could not be recorded
errors.guidance: inspect the journal; a committed operation is never resent automatically

errors.description: policy, corroboration or sensor-integrity gates refuse an alert for this event (not corroborated, held, or open tamper)
errors.guidance: do not retry; obtain independent corroboration or resolve the integrity risk

errors.description: alert relay route is not admissible (exact IP:PORT, plain absolute path, nonzero plaintext-route approval)
errors.guidance: supply an admissible explicit route; no DNS, redirect or TLS downgrade is attempted

errors.description: remote archive unavailable
errors.guidance: local spool obligation; bounded retry

errors.description: published object failed retrieval/integrity check
errors.guidance: quarantine/repair/escalate

errors.description: arithmetic overflow in timestamp or uncertainty calculation
errors.guidance: bound timestamp values within addressable range

errors.description: principal lacks exact capability
errors.guidance: do not retry without new authority

errors.description: explicit original-read or selected destination-retention grant, or the separate live execution context, refused bounded local backup work
errors.guidance: restore explicit authority; replay context alone never grants access to originals

errors.description: cooperative cancellation stopped backup or restore before activation; any copied historical bytes remain behind the incomplete marker
errors.guidance: inspect the partial destination; choose a fresh destination after explicit cleanup, never dispatch copied work

errors.description: selected backup or restore destination already exists; no overwrite or merge occurred
errors.guidance: inspect existing retained work and select a new destination

errors.description: final activation may be visible but directory durability could not be established; reported status is indeterminate
errors.guidance: inspect the exact destination, manifest and fence before retrying; never overwrite, resend or claim definite refusal

errors.description: local I/O failed before a recovery completion could be established
errors.guidance: inspect retained partial work and the activation marker before choosing a fresh destination

errors.description: complete inventory, journal, file, read-work, report or restore-fence capacity exceeds an explicit current-format ceiling
errors.guidance: review larger supported bounds or choose a compatible source; no truncation, sampling or budget refill

errors.description: an existing source deployment, spool, authority journal or effect journal writer owns a required lock
errors.guidance: quiesce the source and obtain a fresh manifest preview; never repair or reconcile as part of backup

errors.description: selected paths overlap or violate the strict supported local path contract
errors.guidance: select distinct regular local roots with existing regular parents; do not follow symlinks

errors.description: the complete source preview, independently pinned manifest or a previously checked file changed
errors.guidance: review a new complete source preview or restore the independently expected bundle; do not blindly retry a changed pin

errors.description: unknown format/profile, unsupported populated state, unsafe file type or mismatched exact DeploymentLimits prevents complete current-format recovery
errors.guidance: supply exact original limits or a recovery profile owning all retained state; never omit independent agent stores or migrate implicitly

errors.description: the source or staged restore has incomplete publication/deletion work, journal tails or unresolved recovery state
errors.guidance: use its explicit owning recovery path; snapshotting and restore never silently repair the source

errors.description: canonical manifest, native journal, spool object, publication linkage or recovery provenance failed verification
errors.guidance: repair or obtain independently verified original custody; do not re-pin tampered bytes as a fix

errors.description: declared work budget exhausted
errors.guidance: return bounded partial/abstention

errors.description: a retained adoption receipt, chain or recording could not be read or validated, or the adoption could not be staged or committed (custody, ledger refusal, cancellation)
errors.guidance: inspect the cause; retry only after repair; damaged adoption custody is never treated as not adopted

errors.description: a `calibration adopt --approve` digest matches neither this adoption over the bound cameras' current retained adoptions nor the approval that retained them (stale or tampered); nothing was written
errors.guidance: rerun without the approval and review the current approval digest

errors.description: a `calibration adopt` request is outside its contract (no or more than 16 bindings, a camera or sensor bound twice, a camera the calibration does not name, a zero handle or generation); nothing was written
errors.guidance: correct the bindings; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: the adoption would lower the camera's intrinsics or extrinsics generation below its current adoption, or re-adopt a calibration the camera already superseded; adoption is monotone and history is never erased; nothing was written
errors.guidance: recalibrate the camera for a current generation and adopt that calibration

errors.description: the camera's adoptions already bind another sensor, or the sensor is already bound to another camera handle; a camera's sensor binding is fixed; nothing was written
errors.guidance: bind the camera to its adopted sensor; a replaced physical camera takes a new handle

errors.description: an adopted camera's calibration was applied to a recording of another sensor than the one its adoption binds; refused before any frame is decoded, nothing was appended
errors.guidance: pair each --camera with a recording of its adopted sensor

errors.description: `calibration adopt --bind NAME:SENSOR` names a sensor that no readable retained sensor capsule names, so the camera cannot be bound to it; nothing was written
errors.guidance: import evidence of that sensor first, or correct the sensor id

errors.description: `corroborate --calibration` names a calibration a camera's retained adoption has superseded (that calibration, or one at a generation not above the adopted one, while a later adoption is current); refused before any frame is decoded, nothing was analysed or appended; currency is the retained owner adoption, not a physical observation
errors.guidance: corroborate with the camera's currently adopted calibration (`calibration show`)

errors.description: `corroborate --calibration` names a calibration never adopted for a camera whose deployment retains adoptions of other calibrations; refused before any frame is decoded, nothing was appended
errors.guidance: adopt the calibration first (`calibration adopt`) or use the adopted one

errors.description: certificate expired/invalidated/residual failure
errors.guidance: no geometry-dependent negative evidence

errors.description: canonical bytes declare more collection elements than the bytes that remain (truncated buffer)
errors.guidance: re-fetch the complete canonical bytes; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: capability registry or markdown documentation file is missing or corrupt
errors.guidance: repair or restore capability registry file

errors.description: capability registry digest does not match canonical encoding of sorted rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical capability registry digest

errors.description: capability row lacks a default role or default grant policy
errors.guidance: declare an explicit default role or default denial in the capability row

errors.description: capability registry row drift between architecture JSON and markdown
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/capabilities.json and registries/CAPABILITIES.md

errors.description: capability stable identifier was reused or renumbered for a different entity
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: capability specifies an unknown or unregistered semantic plane
errors.guidance: assign a recognized semantic plane to the capability row

errors.description: Exact parent approval, native capability, original/model access, retention authority or cooperative cancellation admission failed
errors.guidance: Review the complete outer plan and restore explicit authority. Preserve any durable native progress; never infer permission to reacquire footage.

errors.description: The analysis timer expired at a cooperative I/O or native phase boundary; elapsed capture time is included
errors.guidance: Inspect complete progress rows and use the exact offline continuation. In-progress native calls are not forcibly preempted and earlier retained work is not rolled back.

errors.description: A finite bridge work, archive-read, arithmetic or complete-output bound was exhausted
errors.guidance: Review supported limits for an explicit continuation. Never replenish a consumed account, truncate a success report or recapture automatically.

errors.description: Capture/pin paths already exist, a required parent/model file is unavailable, or resolved resources overlap or violate the admitted path shape
errors.guidance: Select separate resources with existing parents and a regular pinned package. After acquisition, preserve the existing archive/pins and resume offline analysis.

errors.description: The returned native attempt or typed observation is not a complete settled capture with exact requested pictures and verified catalog/snapshot/journal pins, or import/retention identities disagree
errors.guidance: Preserve native recovery evidence and inspect custody. No detector success, automatic capture retry, event publication or alert dispatch is authorized.

errors.description: Protect file identity, selected view/quality, transport or complete native capture plan no longer matches its outer approval
errors.guidance: Review a fresh complete plan; never reuse a stale approval after file replacement or selection changes.

errors.description: Package view was requested without an explicit true hasPackageCamera capability
errors.guidance: Refresh the camera export or explicitly select a supported main view; a package URI cannot invent package-camera capability.

errors.description: Selected URL port or literal IP differs from the owner-approved peer
errors.guidance: Correct the explicit peer and preview again; no DNS lookup or alternate-route fallback occurs.

errors.description: Private Protect camera/stream handoff is malformed, outside bounds, not owner-only, changed, or inconsistent with the approved native capture plan
errors.guidance: Repair the exact private input and preview again; no alternate camera, quality or route is selected.

errors.description: Selected quality is explicitly null and supplies no enabled stream URL
errors.guidance: Enable the intended stream through the owner's Protect interface and refresh the export; capture changes no camera settings.

errors.description: Selected quality is absent from the chosen stream map; availability is unknown
errors.guidance: Refresh the complete export or explicitly select an available quality; missing is never inferred disabled or silently substituted.

errors.description: Selected Protect URL requires secure transport, or the explicit operator RTSP map is absent or contains a secure URL
errors.guidance: Supply an independently verified plaintext endpoint with explicit operator-rtsp selection and plaintext authorization, or use a qualified secure transport; never rewrite the published URL automatically.

errors.description: promoted proof or bounded_model claim declares no assumptions, or an assumption lacks a non-empty id and statement
errors.guidance: declare every named assumption before promotion; no retry without them

errors.description: bounded_model derivation records no usable inputs or arithmetic formula, the formula is not its expression right-hand side, or it does not recompute the derived value
errors.guidance: record every input with value and units and the exact arithmetic yielding the derived value

errors.description: bounded_model claim derivation is missing, not on disk, digest-unbound, malformed, stepless, or not bound to the claim id and generation
errors.guidance: retain the fss.bound_derivation.v1 derivation bound to the claim before promotion

errors.description: bounded_model derivation formula is dimensionally inconsistent (+ or - of different units, or propagated units differ from the derivation units)
errors.guidance: correct the formula or input units; units are never converted implicitly

errors.description: bounded_model claim bound expression, comparator, or value is missing, non-finite, bound to another claim, or differs from the derivation
errors.guidance: bind the exact derived bound expression to the claim

errors.description: bounded_model derivation declares no sensitivity analysis or no invalidators
errors.guidance: retain sensitivity analysis and invalidators with the derivation

errors.description: bounded_model claimed bound is tighter than the analytically derived bound
errors.guidance: claim at most the derived bound or retain a derivation supporting the tighter one

errors.description: bounded_model claim bound or derivation declares no units, or the claimed units differ from the derivation units
errors.guidance: declare identical explicit units in claim and derivation; never convert implicitly

errors.description: bounded_model claimed, derived, or input value lies outside its registered unit domain (negative, above 100 percent, above 1 auprc)
errors.guidance: correct the value or its unit

errors.description: promoted claim of a class the checker does not realize with evidence inspection (only slo, proof, bounded_model are realized)
errors.guidance: realize the class row or keep the claim unpromoted

errors.description: a registry binding claim ids to classes (architecture/invariants.json) declares an inexact id or one id more than once
errors.guidance: give every stable id exactly one row

errors.description: a promoted proof bundle's claim id is bound to a claim class by no registry (SLO ids by registries/SLOS.md, invariant ids by architecture/invariants.json); a row Class column or the bundle never resolves it
errors.guidance: bind the claim id in its owning registry; no retry until one does

errors.description: a JSON document the claim checker reads (proof bundle, qualification receipt, retained evidence document, or registry, including every architecture/*.json the stable-ID tombstone index reads, which leaves the index unavailable) declares the same key twice in one object, at any nesting level; with a plain parser the last value would silently win
errors.guidance: declare every key once; a document that says two things is never read as one of them

errors.description: an evidence document the claim checker reads declares a key outside its exact field set: the proof bundle, an artifact entry, an assumption, the theorem, the toolchain identity, the formal model reference, manifest, or model source, the proof check receipt, the bound, the derivation, a derivation input, a sensitivity entry, an slo measurement, or its measurement_window; or a qualification receipt declares a case, whitespace, or format-character variant of a field the checker relies on. Keys are compared byte for byte (no case folding, stripping, or normalization)
errors.guidance: remove the key or spell it exactly as the document's field set names it; unknown fields are never ignored

errors.description: promoted proof or bounded_model claim is cited by no claim row declaring its current generation (Generation column), or its citing rows conflict
errors.guidance: declare the claim row's current generation and bind the bundle to exactly it

errors.description: A claim class ID is duplicated, renumbered, or reused across different claim classes
errors.guidance: give every stable id exactly one row; never reuse or renumber stable ids

errors.description: A claim class entry in the registry is missing required normative fields (id, meaning, minimum_evidence, requiredEvidence) or a table row lacks required columns
errors.guidance: declare all required normative fields for each claim class row

errors.description: A claim cites a proof bundle, or a bundle declares an artifact, that does not exist on disk, has forbidden traversal ('..'), is absolute, resolves outside the repository root, is not a regular file, or cannot be verified locally
errors.guidance: retain the cited proof bundle at the declared path before promotion

errors.description: a proof bundle's schema is missing or not exactly `fss.proof_bundle.v1`, or its bundle_id is present but not an exact token
errors.guidance: declare the schema byte for byte and, when present, a bundle_id of printable ASCII with no whitespace

errors.description: proof check receipt is missing, malformed, non-passing, or not bound to the claim, formal model, and formal artifact digest
errors.guidance: re-run the formal checker and retain a passing bound receipt

errors.description: A proof bundle binds no claim ID or a different claim than the one citing it, a promoted claim row has no claim ID, or a claim cites a qualification receipt (which binds no claim)
errors.guidance: bind the proof bundle to the exact claim id that cites it

errors.description: A proof bundle's content digest or an artifact digest is missing, ambiguous, malformed, or does not match the actual computed cryptographic digest
errors.guidance: declare one content digest per artifact and recompute it after any edit

errors.description: An input file is empty (0 bytes or empty text), contains an empty JSON collection, or a required claim surface declares no claim table
errors.guidance: provide non-empty inputs; empty files or collections are not evidence

errors.description: proof claim formal artifact is absent, not on disk, empty, digest-unbound, or not written in the declared checker language
errors.guidance: retain the exact checked formal artifact before promotion

errors.description: proof claim declares no formal model, or its retained fss.formal_model.v1 manifest or source is missing, unreadable, digest-unbound, or not bound to the claim id
errors.guidance: retain the declared formal model bound to the claim id before promotion

errors.description: A proof bundle declares no claim class, a claim class not recognized in architecture/claims.json, or no claim-class registry was supplied
errors.guidance: declare a claim class registered in architecture/claims.json

errors.description: A claim level (e.g. achieved, qualified, verified) is higher than its retained proof supports, the proof is non-passing, or required evidence for the claim class is missing
errors.guidance: retain proof evidence for every claimed level before raising the level

errors.description: proof claim formal model generation differs from the claim generation, the declared model reference, or the check receipt
errors.guidance: re-check the proof at the claim generation; never splice generations

errors.description: A claim attempts a promotion explicitly prohibited by architecture/claims.json
errors.guidance: remove the prohibited promotion; claim only what the retained evidence supports

errors.description: promoted proof bundle passed the static pre-filter, but a proof is verified only by a qualification receipt from running the prover, and no such receipt mechanism is defined yet
errors.guidance: a user decision: define the prover-run receipt; until then no proof claim is verified

errors.description: proof bundle references a stale, superseded, tombstoned, expired, or latest-aliased generation, or a generation other than its claim row's current one
errors.guidance: re-qualify at the current generation; never splice generations

errors.description: proof claim is backed only by tests (test-runner toolchain, test source, or test results) instead of a formal artifact
errors.guidance: demote the claim or supply a machine-checked formal proof

errors.description: proof claim theorem statement is missing, bound to another claim, or differs from the statement the check receipt checked
errors.guidance: bind the exact theorem statement to the claim and re-check

errors.description: The stable-ID tombstone index (architecture/stable_id_resolution.json plus the repository stable-ID index) is missing, unreadable, empty, corrupt, or has the wrong schema, so tombstoned identities cannot be refused
errors.guidance: restore or rebuild architecture/stable_id_resolution.json and the registry tombstone rows

errors.description: proof claim formal checker identity is missing, unregistered, latest-aliased, or differs between bundle and check receipt
errors.guidance: pin the exact registered formal checker and version in bundle and receipt

errors.description: proof claim formal artifact contains, outside comments and strings, an unproven placeholder (Lean sorry, sorryAx, admit, stop or a confusable lookalike; TLAPS OMITTED in any case)
errors.guidance: complete the proof; a placeholder is never a checked proof

errors.description: An input file or directory could not be read (including a file over the per-file byte cap, MAX_INPUT_BYTES), decoded, or parsed as valid JSON/Markdown, or is structurally malformed (including a qualification receipt that violates schemas/release_qualification_receipt.v1.json)
errors.guidance: make every input readable and within the per-file byte bound

errors.description: A claim status, bundle status, supported level, retention state, expiry marker, or readiness registry state is outside the closed vocabulary
errors.guidance: use a recognized status/level/retention spelling from the closed vocabularies

errors.description: proof claim formal artifact contains a known unsound escape (Lean axiom, compiler trust, lcProof, kernel bypass, metaprogramming, a #-command, an import outside Init/Std/Lean; TLA+ AXIOM, ASSUMPTION or non-sequent ASSUME, or EXTENDS/INSTANCE of a non-standard module)
errors.guidance: remove the escape; declare assumptions in the bundle and model

errors.description: The machine-readable claims registry (architecture/claims.json) and its human-readable markdown source (registries/CLAIMS.md) differ in claim class IDs, ordering, meaning, minimum evidence, or row count
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/claims.json and registries/CLAIMS.md

errors.description: slo measurement has no single canonical numeric 'actual': it is missing, non-numeric, boolean, negative, overflowing, or rounded-only (an actual-like key is ERR-CLAIM-EVIDENCE-FIELD-UNKNOWN-001)
errors.guidance: retain exactly one finite, non-negative numeric 'actual' in the SLO unit; never report only a rounded value

errors.description: slo measurement declares a comparator that differs from the comparator of its registries/SLOS.md row
errors.guidance: remove the comparator from the measurement; the SLO row alone defines the comparison

errors.description: the measurements behind one slo claim come from different operations, or their validity windows share no common instant
errors.guidance: measure every conjunct of the SLO target on the same operation within overlapping validity windows

errors.description: slo claim retains no single digest-bound fss.environment_manifest.v1 artifact, or the measurement is not bound to that manifest's digest
errors.guidance: retain the exact environment manifest and bind the measurement to its digest

errors.description: an operation-cost row listing the slo claim's SLO declares no measurement_max_age_days (the strictest bound over all such rows applies), so the freshness bound is unset
errors.guidance: a user decision: set the bound on every such row; the checker never assumes a default

errors.description: slo bundle or measurement declares no generation, or the measurement declares no operation-cost registry generation
errors.guidance: bind the bundle and measurement to one explicit generation and to the operation-cost registry generation measured against

errors.description: slo measurement status is missing or anything other than 'passed'
errors.guidance: re-run the measurement; a failed, partial, or unlabelled run never supports an slo claim

errors.description: the SLO registry (registries/SLOS.md) or operation-cost registry (architecture/operation_cost_registry.toml) consulted for an slo claim is missing, unreadable, empty, malformed, or declares no rows or generation
errors.guidance: repair the registry under the audited root; slo claims are never checked against a silently skipped registry

errors.description: slo measurement's declared statistic is not exactly the statistic its SLO target names (missing, different, not byte-exact, or declared for a target naming none; a statistic-like key is ERR-CLAIM-EVIDENCE-FIELD-UNKNOWN-001)
errors.guidance: declare the single canonical 'statistic' exactly as the SLO target names it, or none when it names none

errors.description: slo claim target cannot be resolved to exactly one numeric threshold of its registries/SLOS.md row, the measurement declares no or a different unit, or the measurement restates a target that differs from the authoritative row (a non-canonical target key is ERR-CLAIM-EVIDENCE-FIELD-UNKNOWN-001)
errors.guidance: claim only an SLO row with a registered numeric threshold; measure in its exact unit and never restate or relax the target

errors.description: slo measurement validity window is missing, unparseable, zone-less, empty, finished before it started, or lies in the future
errors.guidance: retain a zone-qualified ISO-8601 measurement window that ended before the evaluation instant

errors.description: option flag was specified more than once
errors.guidance: specify option at most once

errors.description: command-line argument contains invalid UTF-8 bytes
errors.guidance: encode command-line arguments in UTF-8

errors.description: option or argument value cannot be parsed into expected domain
errors.guidance: provide valid typed value before retry

errors.description: required option or positional argument value is missing
errors.guidance: provide required value before retry

errors.description: runtime error occurred during validated command execution
errors.guidance: inspect diagnostic and address failure cause

errors.description: extra argument provided after command grammar is satisfied
errors.guidance: remove trailing argument before retry

errors.description: positional argument provided to command taking no positionals
errors.guidance: remove unexpected positional argument

errors.description: command token is not a recognized CLI command or verb
errors.guidance: do not retry without valid command name

errors.description: option flag is unrecognized for binary or active command
errors.guidance: do not retry without valid option flag

errors.description: Cooperative cancellation interrupted the selected clock-validation profile during native fitting or bounded report construction; outcome is cancelled and no successful report is emitted
errors.guidance: Retry only as a new bounded invocation with the intended complete input; no partial validation or clock activation can be inferred.

errors.description: comparison or association between incompatible clock bases
errors.guidance: convert to common basis or synchronise to UTC

errors.description: clock basis name is unrecognized
errors.guidance: supply a registered clock basis name

errors.description: clock synchronization state unknown when synchronised evidence required
errors.guidance: obtain synchronisation certificate or abstain

errors.description: capture interval too wide for requested operation
errors.guidance: degrade/abstain/recalibrate

errors.description: clock unsynchronised or drift bound exceeds tolerance
errors.guidance: synchronise clock or bound monotonic drift

errors.description: two-sensor corroboration refused by association, the event/policy contract or the storage owner
errors.guidance: inspect the cause; retry only after repair

errors.description: an approval digest matches no corroborated proposal of this exact analysis; nothing was published
errors.guidance: rerun without approval and review the current proposal digests

errors.description: an owner-supplied image-to-ground homography is non-finite, singular, or maps an observed foot point to or beyond the ground horizon; it is an owner assertion, never a calibration certificate
errors.guidance: supply a valid homography for that camera; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: two-sensor corroboration plan is outside its bounds (camera names, 1..16 ground zones, time gate 1..60 s, finite positive distance gate, recordings of 1..128 frames)
errors.guidance: correct the plan; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: an owner calibrated camera pose (`--pose`) is refused for ground-zone visibility: its intrinsics describe another image size than the decoded frames, or it disagrees with the camera's ground homography over a zone; a pose is an owner assertion, never a calibration certificate
errors.guidance: supply a pose consistent with the decoded frames and the homography, or omit it (coverage is then homography-frustum-only); do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a corroborated camera received a pose from both --pose and --calibration; exactly one pose source per camera is allowed; nothing was analysed
errors.guidance: drop the --pose for that camera or use a calibration that does not name it

errors.description: both recordings come from one sensor (or are one import); one failure domain can never corroborate itself
errors.guidance: name recordings from two distinct sensors

errors.description: the two recordings' conservative capture spans do not overlap: clocks are unaligned or the recordings cover different periods
errors.guidance: supply recordings of one period on an aligned time base or abstain

errors.description: a recording has no operator capture-time hint, so its capture time is unknown and cannot be aligned by assumption
errors.guidance: re-import with explicit capture hints or abstain

errors.description: geometric ground-zone visibility could not be assessed: the sampling policy is outside its registered bounds, the owner scene-mesh package was refused (digest, format, references, limits), or a visibility query was degenerate or over its geometry budget; nothing was analysed and no coverage is claimed
errors.guidance: correct the policy or supply the exact scene-mesh package and digests; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a coverage record could not be built, validated, staged or committed (witness domain/predicate/generation mismatch, unknown capture time with a witness, storage refusal)
errors.guidance: inspect the cause; retry only after repair; no absence is certified

errors.description: a `--retain-coverage` approval digest matches neither the fresh analysis's coverage proposal (which binds the authority anchor it read) nor the coverage already retained for that analysis; nothing was retained
errors.guidance: rerun without the approval and review the current coverage approval digest

errors.description: effective observability cannot be established
errors.guidance: abstain/escalate health alert

errors.description: media decode failed
errors.guidance: preserve source; alternate decoder only if registered

errors.description: media exceeds declared bounds
errors.guidance: fail closed

errors.description: retained source bytes or import span metadata disagree with the capsule's source digest or byte count; refused before any codec work, nothing is decoded, staged or receipted
errors.guidance: treat the import as corrupt custody; re-import from the original file, never decode around it

errors.description: a retained source gap lies inside the requested H.264 range; inter prediction cannot bridge omitted bytes
errors.guidance: split the range at the gap and start after it at an IDR

errors.description: requested H.264 decode range does not begin at an IDR access unit, so its first picture would predict from references outside the range
errors.guidance: start the range at an IDR segment

errors.description: H.264 stream uses a profile or coding tool outside the admitted set (progressive 8-bit 4:2:0 Baseline, Main and High); no approximate pixels are produced
errors.guidance: transcode in the laboratory or wait for a registered decoder; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a retained source gap lies inside the requested H.265 range; inter prediction cannot bridge omitted bytes
errors.guidance: split the range at the gap and start after it at an IRAP segment

errors.description: requested H.265 decode range does not begin at an IRAP (IDR, CRA or BLA) access unit, so its first picture would predict from references outside the range
errors.guidance: start the range at an IRAP segment

errors.description: H.265 stream uses a profile, sample format or coding tool outside the admitted set (Main and Main Still Picture, 8-bit 4:2:0, long-term references included; no range extensions, tiles or dependent slices); no approximate pixels are produced
errors.guidance: transcode in the laboratory or wait for a registered decoder; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: operator component interpretation contradicts the media (admitted H.264 and H.265 are always YCbCr 4:2:0)
errors.guidance: resubmit with the correct explicit interpretation

errors.description: requested import, segment or range is absent or its retained custody cannot be recovered
errors.guidance: name an existing completed import and an in-range segment; repair custody before retry

errors.description: retained import's media format is not admitted by the requested decode operation (single-frame JPEG decode/reopen of an Annex-B or HEVC import, H.264 range decode of a JPEG or HEVC import, or H.265 range decode of a JPEG or H.264 import)
errors.guidance: use the format's decode operation; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: the approval is not the exact approval of this deletion plan for this principal; nothing was written
errors.guidance: approve the printed approval digest of the current plan

errors.description: deletion closure blocked by hold/backend/offline copy; realized by `fss-event delete commit` (FSS-037): the sealed plan names an open or indeterminate effect that references the evidence (`open_effect`), a root that failed verification (`broken_root_unclassified`), a conflicting root claim, an earlier incomplete deletion, or a tombstone batch over the bound; nothing was written (the reference deployment has no hold registry yet)
errors.guidance: report exact blockers and obligation; resolve them, plan again, approve the new plan

errors.description: a deletion plan or record exceeded a hard bound
errors.guidance: split the deployment's retained history; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: `delete plan` names no completed, retained import
errors.guidance: check the import identity; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a deletion commit was interrupted after its record became durable, or a removed name is still present; completion was not claimed and every deleted digest already reads `deleted`
errors.guidance: rerun the same `delete commit`; it resumes and completes exactly once

errors.description: no deletion plan recomputed against the current head has the given digest (the deployment changed after planning, or the plan is unknown); nothing was written
errors.guidance: plan again and approve the new plan; never commit a changed plan

errors.description: `delete plan --sensor-id` or `--event-id` reaches no completed, retained import: no retained import's capsules name the sensor, no committed event has the identity, or every member import is already deleted (fss-x4a.30.86.20); nothing was written
errors.guidance: check the sensor or event identity; a deleted member reads `ERR-EVIDENCE-DELETED-001` by `--import-id`

errors.description: deployment custody, ledger or publication storage failed during a deletion plan or commit
errors.guidance: repair storage (`fss doctor`), then rerun the same command

errors.description: architecture/dependency_allowlist.toml bytes diverged from the checker's pinned allowlist digest
errors.guidance: review the allowlist change and update the pinned digest in scripts/dependency_authority.py in the same commit

errors.description: dependency constitution drift between machine registry and markdown documentation, or between DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md and its docs/ copy
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/dependency_constitution.json and docs/DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md, and keep docs/DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md byte-identical to DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md

errors.description: dependency constitution semantic invariant violated
errors.guidance: enforce constitutional admission rule and production closed-universe invariants

errors.description: Cargo metadata violates constitutional language or stdlib requirements for DEP-CLASS-F0, or names a workspace member that is not declared in architecture/crate_topology.json and listed explicitly in the root [workspace].members
errors.guidance: ensure all workspace crates compile under rust-2024 without foreign links, and declare every member in the crate topology and the explicit workspace member list

errors.description: dependency registry or markdown documentation file is missing or corrupt
errors.guidance: repair or restore dependency registry file

errors.description: dependency registry digest does not match canonical encoding of metadata and rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical dependency registry digest

errors.description: a toolchain command required for DEP-CLASS-F0 verification (rustc -Vv or cargo metadata) could not run, timed out, exited non-zero, or produced unparseable output
errors.guidance: restore the pinned toolchain and offline cargo inputs and rerun; an execution failure is never reported as a corrupt file

errors.description: dependency registry digest diverged from pinned baseline freeze digest
errors.guidance: restore frozen dependency registry or bump generation

errors.description: dependency registry generation diverged from baseline generation
errors.guidance: assign expected generation to dependency registry

errors.description: dependency class row or root metadata lacks a mandatory field or is empty/corrupt
errors.guidance: declare all mandatory fields in dependency class row

errors.description: a crate recorded under an open owner decision (dependency_allowlist.toml [pending_owner_decisions], e.g. fss-ndxis) reached a manifest, lockfile, or resolved closure
errors.guidance: keep the crate out of the closure until the owner records the decision; it is neither admitted nor rejected meanwhile

errors.description: dependency registry row drift between machine registry and markdown mirror
errors.guidance: synchronize architecture/dependencies.json and registries/DEPENDENCIES.md

errors.description: dependency class stable identifier was reused, duplicated, renumbered, or tombstoned
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: a dependency or dependency-class tombstone/supersession record is malformed, contradictory, dangling, or missing
errors.guidance: record status, successor, and tombstone decision consistently in architecture/dependencies.json and architecture/stable_id_resolution.json

errors.description: a dependency registry row's owner, producer, consumer, ContractBasis link, or a dependency checker diagnostic code does not resolve
errors.guidance: name existing repository files and allowlist tables that reference the row, and register every emitted code in registries/ERRORS.md

errors.description: the repository enables a nightly unstable feature (#![feature(...)] including inside cfg_attr, -Z rustflags in .cargo/config or checked-in env/shell files, a cargo [unstable] table, cargo-features, or a -Z literal in a build script) while no unstable-feature allowlist is registered
errors.guidance: remove the feature gate or flag, or register an unstable-feature allowlist with owner and removal plan before enabling it

errors.description: a frame the cheap watch gate selected was not inferred because the explicit `--detector-max-inferences` budget was exhausted; a typed per-frame outcome in the report and a non-supporting evidence record, never a silent drop and never evidence of absence
errors.guidance: raise the budget or narrow the range if the frame matters

errors.description: detector-cascade policy outside its bounds (frames per track 1..8, max inferences 1..64, association IoU and score threshold at most 1000000 ppm) or a threshold the package refuses; refused before any source is read
errors.guidance: correct the cascade options; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: exact product/firmware/app tuple not certified
errors.guidance: fail closed or explicit import-only mode

errors.description: Retaining an explicitly enrolled discovery sweep failed scope, immutable binding, bounded inventory, chronology, custody or publication admission
errors.guidance: Inspect the existing deployment and committed prefix. Preserve exact enrollment and sweep window/evidence for an interrupted retry; do not rebind an address, restage a conflicting visible root, repair corruption implicitly or claim media continuity from network return.

errors.description: doctor inspection detected deployment conditions requiring attention
errors.guidance: inspect doctor report and follow next affordance

errors.description: target directory is not a recognized reference deployment root
errors.guidance: provide a valid reference deployment root

errors.description: dispatch outcome cannot be determined
errors.guidance: reconcile before retry

errors.description: the requested import (or its derivative) was deleted under a committed deletion record; availability `deleted`, not missing; a deleted import identity is never re-imported
errors.guidance: do not retry; the record names the deletion plan

errors.description: canonical root references unavailable required evidence
errors.guidance: repair; no adjudication requiring it

errors.description: an input tensor's generation differs from the graph generation; tensors of different generations are never mixed, outcome `error`
errors.guidance: rebuild the input under the graph's generation; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: the Model IR validator or shape inference refused the graph (dangling port, cycle, invalid attribute, version or arity); nothing executed, outcome `error`
errors.guidance: repair the graph and re-validate; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a declared graph input port has no bound tensor in the invocation; refused before execution, outcome `error`
errors.guidance: bind every declared input; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a completed scalar run cannot be bound into its invocation receipt: an output root over the declared outputs or the operator trace over every executed node's output digest (intermediates included) cannot be computed or contradicts the outputs; the invocation fails with outcome `error`, never `ok` with absent digests
errors.guidance: treat the run as failed and report it; re-run only after the executor defect is fixed

errors.description: integer overflow in the executor's MAC, byte or index accounting; refused rather than wrapped, outcome `error`
errors.guidance: reduce the graph or input size; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: an input or intermediate tensor shape contradicts the graph declaration or the operator's shape rules, or an intermediate port is missing; outcome `error`, nothing is bound
errors.guidance: fix the graph or the preprocessing that produced the input; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a tensor could not be constructed, materialized or digested within its storage bounds during execution; outcome `error`
errors.guidance: reduce the tensor sizes or repair the input; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a graph port, input tensor or inferred node output has a data type the scalar executor does not admit (F32 only, except exact embedding-index bindings); refused before or during execution, outcome `error`
errors.guidance: convert the model or input to the admitted dtype; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a model graph node names an operator the scalar reference executor has no kernel for; the invocation receipt records outcome `error`, no output root or operator trace
errors.guidance: use a graph within the frozen operator table; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: the Model IR version of the graph is not the version the scalar executor implements; refused before execution, outcome `error`
errors.guidance: re-export the graph at the supported IR version; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: approval does not bind the exact current redacted export
errors.guidance: preview and approve the exact package

errors.description: complete redacted export exceeds a registered bound
errors.guidance: narrow the supported export request; nothing is truncated

errors.description: export was cancelled before its authoritative commit
errors.guidance: retry the exact request after reconciling any published root

errors.description: retained export/event custody differs from the approved package
errors.guidance: stop export and inspect deployment custody

errors.description: attested current-time interval reaches or crosses exclusive export expiry
errors.guidance: obtain a new authorized expiry and preview the exact request again; existing plaintext copies are not erased

errors.description: event or retained source does not meet the fixed complete video-only original-media disclosure profile
errors.guidance: use an admitted native RTSP MP4 or omission-free MJPEG source and supported original long event; there is no mask or channel override

errors.description: event export request is malformed, unbounded, or has expiry not later than the event interval
errors.guidance: correct the exact event/recipient/purpose/expiry and preview again

errors.description: selected event revision is no longer current
errors.guidance: read the current event and preview a new export

errors.description: local root-last export publication or authority append failed
errors.guidance: inspect local custody/recovery before retrying

errors.description: observed device generation differs from registry
errors.guidance: disable/move to shadow; no optimistic retry

errors.description: frozen public registry digest does not match canonical encoding of sorted rows
errors.guidance: recompute canonical freeze digest over sorted rows

errors.description: public operation or resource was added, removed, renamed, or renumbered without a new registry generation
errors.guidance: bump the registry generation and update the frozen public registry

errors.description: stable operation or resource identifier was reused for a different entity
errors.guidance: allocate a new unique stable identifier; never reuse stable IDs

errors.description: tombstoned operation or resource was resurrected into active registry
errors.guidance: allocate a new identifier; tombstoned entries remain permanently retired

errors.description: crosswalk or presentation surface references an unregistered operation
errors.guidance: register operation in frozen registry or correct surface reference

errors.description: Checkpoint bytes disagree with the independently supplied SHA-256 or embedded checksum
errors.guidance: Obtain the exact originally pinned bytes; recomputing a pin from unknown input is not recovery.

errors.description: Source-once checkpoint is truncated, noncanonical, duplicated, has trailing data or inconsistent numerical/source state
errors.guidance: Repair from the exact retained checkpoint; no partial restoration or history certification is returned.

errors.description: Complete source-once checkpoint bytes, source/domain inventory or reset text exceed the frozen allowance
errors.guidance: Retain the existing owner/checkpoint; do not truncate, evict sources or silently initialize a new process.

errors.description: Source-once checkpoint declares an unsupported version
errors.guidance: Use its producing compatible reader; there is no implicit downgrade or migration.

errors.description: an fss-fusion query is outside its contract (empty, oversized or control-character identity, duplicate observation/opportunity/probe, an item without failure domains, an inverted or out-of-bound log-likelihood interval or window, zero looks, too many items); nothing was fused
errors.guidance: correct the query; inputs are refused, never repaired; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: an exact integer log-odds sum or threshold left its domain; no wrapped or saturated belief was produced
errors.guidance: treat as an implementation defect or hostile input; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: an fss-fusion decision policy is inconsistent (thresholds not reject < retain <= alert, zero independent support, urgent threshold below retain, look penalty out of range); nothing was decided
errors.guidance: supply a valid, versioned policy generation; never adapt it online

errors.description: The explicit source-once profile did not receive exactly one binding for every original evidence identity, or an observed calibrated item lacks a source key
errors.guidance: Correct the complete binding inventory; no accumulator, source inventory or receipt state changed.

errors.description: The complete new numeric-source inventory would exceed the selected nonrefillable lifetime allowance
errors.guidance: Select a sufficient complete allowance for a new explicit invocation; no prefix was consumed, identity evicted or capacity refunded.

errors.description: A canonical declared source key was reused with incompatible immutable item semantics, including conflicting aliases within the same query
errors.guidance: Inspect original source and interpretation; a relabel, retry or reset cannot reinterpret consumed evidence. The whole step was refused.

errors.description: a declared graph budget (operations or output entries) ran out before the exact answer was complete; no partial answer or witness was produced
errors.guidance: raise the budget within the registered bound or narrow the projection

errors.description: a caller cancellation probe interrupted a graph run or its nested certified solver before completion; no answer, partial optimum or witness was produced
errors.guidance: retry only with a valid new cancellation/deadline allowance; retain the same source and declared input pins when replaying

errors.description: an observed graph operation counter exceeded the registered complexity or output bound for the input size, at run time or when a witness is re-checked; no answer is trusted
errors.guidance: treat as an implementation defect or tampered witness; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a graph projection or request is outside the strict graph policy (empty, oversized or control-character node identity, duplicate node, unknown endpoint or root, self-loop, parallel edge, or node/edge limit); nothing was analysed
errors.guidance: correct the projection; inputs are refused, never repaired; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: graph algorithm row lacks declared complexity witness operations
errors.guidance: declare dominant operation complexity witness in graph algorithm registry

errors.description: graph algorithm row lacks declared output-size witness with bounds
errors.guidance: declare output-size witness with bounds or record explicit owner drift

errors.description: graph algorithm row lacks a deterministic CGSE tie-break rule
errors.guidance: specify a deterministic CGSE tie-break policy in graph algorithm registry

errors.description: a checked sum of exact u64 graph weights (distance, schedule time, flow, capacity or cost) left the u64 domain; no wrapped, saturated or approximate answer was produced
errors.guidance: rescale the projection unit or narrow the projection; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: a well-formed graph projection violates the registered algorithm's declared precondition (wrong orientation, a cycle where a DAG is required, source equal to sink, empty or duplicated source set); nothing was analysed
errors.guidance: supply a projection that meets the precondition (for a cycle, condense it with ALG-SCC-001 first); do not retry unchanged

errors.description: graph algorithm projections differ between machine source and registry markdown mirror
errors.guidance: reconcile machine source and registry markdown projections

errors.description: a projection-level answer derived from a graph run disagrees with the projection's structural invariant (for example coverage single points versus the witnessed observers); nothing was reported
errors.guidance: treat as an implementation defect; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: graph algorithm stable identifier renumbered or superseded row not tombstoned
errors.guidance: restore stable algorithm identity and retain superseded rows as tombstones

errors.description: graph algorithm specifies an unregistered or nonexistent graph projection ID
errors.guidance: update algorithm projection to a registered projection ID from docs/GRAPH_ALGORITHM_ATLAS.md

errors.description: an `fss-hold --approve` digest no longer names the exact prepared transition over the current authority head; nothing was written
errors.guidance: rerun without the approval and approve the printed digest

errors.description: retained hold history or active held-closure bounds are exhausted (registries/evidence_holds.json limits); holds are never evicted
errors.guidance: release holds or raise the reviewed bound

errors.description: the hold operation was cancelled cooperatively, including before a staged record was appended
errors.guidance: retry the same request; approvals stay exact

errors.description: a deletion of the import is committed but not complete, so preservation can no longer be promised; retention mutations are refused
errors.guidance: finish or reconcile the deletion first

errors.description: an `fss-hold` request is outside its contract: invalid bounded request, unknown hold on release, identifier already bound to another import or placement, or a released identifier reused; nothing was written
errors.guidance: correct the request; identifiers are never reused

errors.description: hold authority is missing, corrupt, shadowed or inconsistent, or an underlying ledger, spool, import or deletion-history read failed; never treated as no hold
errors.guidance: repair the deployment; do not delete while unresolved

errors.description: Exact outer capture/model approval, current native capability or cancellation admission refused the composed operation
errors.guidance: Review the complete outer plan and restore current authority. Neither nested approval grants the combined operation; preserve any original or retained progress.

errors.description: The analysis deadline expired at a cooperative phase or I/O boundary, including time spent in capture
errors.guidance: Use the exact saved offline continuation after checking custody. Capture has its separately approved deadline; no native call is forcibly preempted and no allowance is silently renewed.

errors.description: Bounded model/preflight/history/import work, archive I/O, arithmetic or complete parent output exceeded its ceiling
errors.guidance: Review explicit bounds for an offline continuation; do not truncate a report, refill per generation or reacquire a camera automatically.

errors.description: The archive already exists, parents/model are unavailable, or canonical archive/deployment/package paths overlap or violate admitted file types
errors.guidance: Select separate resources with existing parents and a regular pinned model. Preserve an existing archive and continue from exact offline pins rather than live recapture.

errors.description: Capture request was not satisfied, the typed receipt lacks its required settled history or exact single-generation requested-count prefix, or cold source/import identities disagree
errors.guidance: Preserve native source and history/recovery pins. Unsatisfied capture cannot trigger automatic perception or camera retry. Failed-but-ended custody can be analyzed only by a separately approved offline request.

errors.description: Exact owner approval, current source/import/model/retention authority, cancellation or cooperative deadline refused processing
errors.guidance: Inspect durable imports and retained analyses, restore current authority and retry the exact intended plan; a refusal does not erase earlier progress.

errors.description: Whole-history source/decode/model/report admission, resident output reservation, checked arithmetic or complete output exceeded its ceiling
errors.guidance: Select a smaller exact history or explicitly review new bounds; resources never refill per connection and no connection/report is silently truncated.

errors.description: The explicitly selected local native model could not be read as bounded ordinary verified custody
errors.guidance: Supply the intended readable local archive and independent digest outside both stores; no download or inferred replacement is attempted.

errors.description: Exact history/model/backend, ordered source/camera/capture bindings, sampling, paths or resource configuration is invalid
errors.guidance: Review the complete pure preview and correct the declared plan; no implicit latest history, model or capture timing is selected.

errors.description: current original-read or destination-retention permission, cancellation, cooperative timeout or exact CLI approval refused history processing
errors.guidance: inspect already retained imports; restore explicit authority before retrying the same plan, or review a new approval for changed bounds

errors.description: whole-history reservation, checked aggregate arithmetic, complete report or command capacity exceeds the admitted ceiling
errors.guidance: select a smaller exact history or review new bounds; no connection, frame or candidate may be silently omitted or supplied fresh allowances

errors.description: exact history pin, complete ordered generation bindings, explicit capture assumptions, source/destination separation, native watch configuration or per-generation report hints are invalid
errors.guidance: correct the complete plan and review a new exact original-retention approval; no implicit generation or time binding is allowed

errors.description: CLI approval does not match the exact HTTP import plan
errors.guidance: review the current no-I/O preview and approve that exact plan

errors.description: original-read or destination-retention authority, cancellation or deadline refused the import
errors.guidance: restore explicit authority or choose new bounds; inspect retained progress before retry

errors.description: retained import construction, existing committed custody, journal capacity or root-last publication refused
errors.guidance: inspect the existing owner error and retained progress; exact retry cannot repair damaged committed evidence

errors.description: HTTP archive import source selection, storage-owner separation, camera/time declaration or resource bounds are invalid, or native replay reached the exact prefix without a complete original JPEG
errors.guidance: correct the exact request and obtain its new approval; a prefix without a complete JPEG is not a quiet-scene or completion claim

errors.description: pinned original HTTP chain, native framing, source mapping or source-read work allowance was refused
errors.guidance: repair or select verified source custody; never substitute reconstructed bytes for damaged originals

errors.description: Current original-read/import/model/retention authority or cancellation admission refused the selected prefix operation
errors.guidance: Restore current explicit authority and inspect durable originals/imports. An old capture or retained model grants no current operation or reacquisition permission.

errors.description: The single prefix computation exceeded its shared native work/output or checked allocation ceiling
errors.guidance: Choose a supported first-N schedule or review explicit resource bounds. No budget refills per burst and no partial success report.

errors.description: The typed durable-import observer declined progress before native model work
errors.guidance: Preserve the exact retained import and source pin. Perform a separately admitted cold continuation; model execution did not begin through this observer refusal.

errors.description: Exact native original prefix, acknowledged first-N range, package/backend/threshold, native schedule or current source/privacy identity is inconsistent
errors.guidance: Review the explicit bounded selection and current custody. Read-ahead remains retained but outside the selected range; never infer EOF or replace originals.

errors.description: H2 decision artifact privacy class is not `private:property`, the only privacy class fss-core uses; raw or unredacted media included (code `invalid_privacy_class`)
errors.guidance: supply the authorized privacy class; do not retry unchanged

errors.description: H2 redaction transform is not a recognized `transform:*` token or is incompatible with the artifact kind (code `invalid_redaction_transform`)

schemas.compatibilityRule: Complete Estimated/Derived cell, full anchor including privacy epoch, journal root, exact native producer/receipt and ordered eight-role payload/authority/revision closure. Original retained JPEG bytes are Observed content; result, invocation, decode and capsule metadata are Derived. Equal content preserves all roles and distinct origins. Canonical integrity encoding uses fss.canonical.v1 plus this tag, full anchor/journal root, producer algorithm/generation/derivation receipt, typed cell, checked u8 role count and ordered role/origin/digest/ObjectId/full ObjectRevision; at most eight roles, supporting references and contradictions, with checked completion before hashing. The private verified type is constructed only after native custody and replay checks; JSON and its integrity digest remain untrusted until independent native re-verification. No physical scene, capture-time, calibration, future custody, session or effect authority.

Explicit verify-activity --report-profile producer-origins-v1 adds the complete producer-origin projection to the existing verified activity result under the same output, custody and cancellation limits. Default and explicit v1 retain their original report bytes. Every transferred claim must be checked against an independently obtained native observation; self-consistent hashes, declared origins and deserialization cannot create verified status.
